name: provider-technical-due-diligence
title_zh: 支付与开放金融供应商的尽调审阅员
tagline_zh: 选支付商、开放金融或金融基建前，别只看官网宣传。它用MCP直连官方文档逐条核验，给出评分、风险清单和待追问问题。
tagline_en: Before picking a payment or Open Finance vendor, skip the marketing. It cross-checks official docs via MCP, then.
desc_en: Analisa tecnicamente provedores de pagamentos, Open Finance e infraestrutura financeira usando prioritariamente MCP e documentação oficial. Produz análise fundamentada, score estimado, riscos e questões em aberto.
why_zh: 机制上拒绝二手资料：优先走MCP拉取官方文档，核验链可回溯。结论分四层——依据、评分、风险、待办。
why_en: It refuses second-hand sources: pulls official docs via MCP, so every claim is traceable. Output splits into evidence, score.
limit_zh: 只覆盖支付、开放金融与金融基建的技术尽调；不碰商业条款、合规牌照或合同谈判。若供应商无公开官方文档或MCP不可达。
limit_en: Covers only technical due diligence for payments, Open Finance, and financial infra. No commercial terms, licensing, or contract advice. If no.
title_en: Payment & Open Finance vendor due diligence, official docs.
